original_test_intent: Execute the complete approved NVIDIA NVRASTool qualification for Grace RAS/EDAC/CPER behavior and demonstrate the authoritative 100% result.
original_method: An authorized operator pins the NVRASTool/rasdaemon stack and expanded manifest, inventories baseline error state, approves every observation or injection scenario, runs under independent monitoring, preserves CPER/EDAC/BMC/kernel evidence and verifies the denominator.
manual_activity: The owner approves the vendor package, suite and every fault stimulus; an authorized operator runs the pinned NVRAS qualification while monitoring console and system safety and preserving per-case CPER/EDAC evidence.
required_inputs: rasdaemon version, configuration, service state and database retention
Complete resolved test manifest and RAS/CPER reference revisions
Authoritative decision whether the target is NVRAS 100% or a distinct GPG metric
For every case: observation or injection, component/error class, correctable severity and expected propagation
Privileges, kernel/BMC/firmware compatibility and log destinations
Per-injection abort, recovery, data-integrity protection and independent console
safety_requirements: Do not run until every injection-capable case and recovery path is disclosed and approved
Never inject uncorrectable, fatal or persistence-affecting errors outside the approved isolated configuration
Preserve pre-existing EDAC, CPER, kernel and BMC evidence; do not clear logs for a clean baseline
Avoid the source's embedded password and disabled host-key verification
Stop on unexpected machine check, reboot, uncorrectable error, data corruption, lost console, power or thermal breach
No automatic suite or fault-injection retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify package, manifest, reference and compatibility identities
Collect credential-safe read-only EDAC, rasdaemon, kernel, CPER and BMC baselines
Check that every case has an approved stimulus/evidence/recovery contract
Parse raw per-case artifacts and calculate the denominator
Perform no unapproved injection, log clear, privileged suite launch, reset/reboot, retry or verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve NVRAS/GPG terminology and authoritative criterion
Provide package, manifest, references and supported rasdaemon setup
Approve each fault class, limit, abort and recovery plus denominator policy
Review preserved evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: EDAC/rasdaemon/dmesg checks are useful baseline context, but the insecure SSH pattern and tail-only error sample cannot prove suite completion or safe injection behavior.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run only the approved vendor manifest through its documented launcher; capture full RAS sources with secure access and preserve rather than clear pre-existing records.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All NVRASTool coverage, cited RAS/CPER references, 100% target and 30/60-minute estimates remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: CRITICAL PACKAGE-GATED RAS QUALIFICATION PENDING METRIC DECISION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind every manifest case to component, error severity, injection mechanism, expected OS/BMC/CPER propagation and recovery; execute serially under independent monitoring and calculate the authoritative metric from immutable results.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds fault taxonomy, injection interlocks, evidence preservation, denominator, terminology resolution and recovery without reducing source coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Read-only EDAC/rasdaemon/dmesg inventory is prerequisite evidence only and cannot replace vendor stimuli or per-case outcomes.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: RAS injection can trigger firmware-first handling, asynchronous CPER delivery, containment, reboot or fatal state. A generic pass banner cannot show whether the expected layer observed the right error, and clearing logs can erase evidence needed to distinguish a new event from baseline noise.

project_override_considerations: Any destructive or unsupported injection may be separately marked BLOCKED/N/A by exact case ID, but it stays outside the pass numerator unless the authoritative NVIDIA policy explicitly permits exclusion. Observation-only substitution does not preserve injection coverage.
expected_evidence: Resolved manifest with observation/injection taxonomy, limits and recoveries
Immutable pre/during/post EDAC, rasdaemon, CPER, kernel, BMC and console evidence per case
Independent pass/fail/skip/error denominator and NVRAS/GPG decision
No-log-clear/no-unsafe-injection/no-auto-retry audit, restored health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master Criteria says NVRAS pass rate 100%, while the source AI evidence request says 'GPG 100% NVRAS pass target'. GPG is not defined, so the authoritative metric and denominator cannot be assumed.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The case remains package-gated and statically reviewable. Execution can proceed after the vendor package, injection contracts and metric decision are supplied.

engineering_decision_pending: Resolve Functionality row 1916 Wistron-GB NV PVP SW-00002-V002: whether the authoritative target is NVRAS 100% or a distinct GPG-related metric; define complete manifest/denominator and per-case observation/injection, expected CPER/EDAC propagation, aborts and recovery while preserving Master.
review_improvement: Adds per-case RAS fault semantics, evidence preservation, safety interlocks and an explicit metric decision to a previously insecure partial inventory proposal.
independent_technical_reasoning: A RAS tool can report successful injection even when the error is logged at the wrong layer, classified with the wrong severity, or never reaches the expected CPER consumer. Qualification must correlate injection acknowledgment, hardware/firmware containment and OS/BMC records for each named case. The undefined GPG term also prevents a trustworthy aggregate until engineering identifies the metric and denominator.
